rca of the issue: B1 'TEST_iter8_pending stays pending' failure. Reproduction: set the 2 TEST_iter8_pending docs to status 'cancelled' then run `pytest -k B1` -> fails exactly at line 71 (assert 0 == 2) while the preceding diff(before, after)==[] assertion PASSES. That proves the product restored the notifications exactly as they were before the cleanup (cancelled in, cancelled out); nothing processed/cancelled them during the run. Root cause: add_pending_notifs() only inserts when no TEST_iter8_pending docs exist and never normalises their status, while the only reset back to 'pending' is at the end of test_D1 (line 186, happy path only). Any earlier aborted D1 run, a manual CLI restore (manual=True cancels pending), a manual orders-only cleanup/qa_iter8_block unblock, etc. leaves them 'cancelled' and the next run's B1 fails. Also checked product side: WA worker only claims status=pending AND next_attempt_at<=now (TEST docs are +30 days); startup recovery uses cancel_pending=False; only the manual CLI path cancels — consistent with design. Mitigation applied (test-only): add_pending_notifs() now always resets TEST_iter8_pending to pending/far next_attempt_at and unsets last_error. Suggest also moving the D1 reset into a try/finally.
